title: Stratified alert degrader and structured handoff manifest
author: Elias Moretti
description: Context: Pager fatigue remains a major operational cost for services with noisy, low-impact alerts. This PR implements a stratified alert degrader that automatically reduces noisy signals to digestible summaries or lower-churn channels when they don't change SLO posture and responders have an elevated load. It also introduces a structured 'handoff manifest' artifact that the on-call rotation system and runbook generator can consume to present a compact, actionable snapshot for the incoming shift. What this PR does: 1) New degrader engine (slo-toolkit/alert_degrader) with pluggable policies based on SLO impact, recent incident frequency, and on-call availability. 2) Exporter that synthesizes a JSON handoff manifest (slo-toolkit/handoff/manifest_v1) containing prioritized alerts, suggested runbook entry, last-triage snapshot, and responsible owners. 3) CLI entrypoint (slo-manifestctl) and a small daemon mode to push manifests to the handoff queue. 4) Playbook exporter updates to include manifest pointers and degradation annotations. Motivation: Reduce unnecessary wakeups while preserving rapid response for true SLO-impacting regressions. Design notes: Degrader is opt-in per-service via a single config flag; policies default to conservative thresholds. The degrader never supresses alerts that cross SLO error budget boundaries; instead it changes routing/urgency. Tests: Unit coverage for policy evaluation, integration test with mock oncall API, e2e that validates manifest schema and runbook linking. Commits: feat(degrader): initial engine and policy framework; feat(handoff): manifest schema + exporter; cli: manifestctl and daemon scaffold; tests: unit + integration + e2e; docs: runbook examples and operator guide. Files changed (high level): alert_degrader/index.ts, handoff/manifest_v1.proto, cli/manifestctl.ts, exporters/playbook_exporter.ts, tests/integration/degrader.spec.ts, docs/operator/handoff-guide.md, ci/workflows/manifest-e2e.yml. Review summary: First iteration implemented core flow and schema; Rosa asked for telemetry labels to be normalized and to add a small counter metric for degraded alerts per-service; addressed in second commit. Priya requested clearer failure-mode behavior for handoff pushes (fallback to S3 store) and an operator-facing toggle; added in daemon mode. Liam suggested shrinking manifest payload by moving large attachments to ephemeral store and including a pointer; implemented as manifest.attachments[]. Outcome: Approved after two iterations, CI green, merged by squash. Merge method: squash. Related work: ENG-4821 (alert noise reduction initiative), PM-193 (oncall handoff improvements).
release_notes: Adds opt-in stratified alert degrader and structured handoff manifest export. Operator guide included. Backwards-compatible; opt-in by config.
review_decision: Approved by Priya Natarajan after addressing telemetry labeling and fallback push behavior; Rosa Chen verified metrics; Liam O'Connor verified manifest size optimization.
